excerpt.zh: 反向散射能谱传感器显示行星地壳中存在珍贵物质。
excerpt.en: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances in the planet's crust.

texts.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]就[From.GetName]的矿藏进行了详细报告。由于独特的地壳构造进程，[Root.GetName]的地表附近聚集了大量的珍贵矿脉。
texts.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has provided us with a detailed report on [From.GetName]'s geological riches. Apparently the planet's unique tectonic history has served to concentrate many minerals of interest to the [Root.GetName] near the surface.
